PV_RDCD4_BytesSource.text:
import R1Z.PV_RDCD4_SliceRange194
import R1Z.PV_RDCD4_TryArray194
import R1Z.PV_RDCD4_Endian194
import R1Z.PV_RDCD4_FieldSource
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PV_RDCD4_BytesSource
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev M := ProverRwFull.aspis_core.field.M31
abbrev C := ProverRwFull.aspis_core.field.CM31
abbrev Q := ProverRwFull.aspis_core.field.QM31
/-- Exact source branch on the decoded representative; no implicit reduction. -/
def scalar (bytes : Array U8 4#usize) : Option M :=
  let v := PV_RDCD4_Endian194.word bytes
  if v ≥ PV_RDCD4_FieldSource.aspis_core.field.P then none else some v

def component (bytes : List U8) (start stop : Nat) : Result (Option M) := do
  let part ← PV_RDCD4_SliceRange194.index bytes start stop
  let converted : Option (Array U8 4#usize) :=
    PV_RDCD4_TryArray194.into (T := U8) 4#usize part
  match converted with
  | Option.none => .ok Option.none
  | Option.some value => .ok (scalar value)

/-- CM31 source order: slice/try_into/decode a, short circuit on None, then b.
No eager length-eight check is introduced. -/
def cm (bytes : List U8) : Result (Option C) := do
  let a ← component bytes 0 4
  match a with
  | none => .ok none
  | some a => do
    let b ← component bytes 4 8
    match b with
    | none => .ok none
    | some b => .ok (some ⟨a,b⟩)

/-- QM31 source order: take first half, parse and short circuit, only then take
second half. This is an owned draft over backing bytes, not edited extraction. -/
def qm (bytes : List U8) : Result (Option Q) := do
  let left ← PV_RDCD4_SliceRange194.index bytes 0 8
  let c0 ← cm left
  match c0 with
  | none => .ok none
  | some c0 => do
    let right ← PV_RDCD4_SliceRange194.index bytes 8 16
    let c1 ← cm right
    match c1 with
    | none => .ok none
    | some c1 => .ok (some ⟨c0,c1⟩)

theorem scalar_binding (bytes : Array U8 4#usize) :
    scalar bytes = (let v := core.num.U32.from_le_bytes bytes
      if v ≥ PV_RDCD4_FieldSource.aspis_core.field.P then none else some v) := by
  rw [scalar,PV_RDCD4_Endian194.binding]

#print axioms scalar_binding
end R1Z.PV_RDCD4_BytesSource

PV_RDCD4_SliceRange194.text:
import Aeneas

namespace R1Z.PV_RDCD4_SliceRange194
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

/-- Owned backing-storage view of a native half-open slice. The caller checks
both ordering and upper bound before the raw view is formed. -/
def window {T : Type} (xs : List T) (start stop : Nat) : List T :=
  (xs.drop start).take (stop-start)

def index {T : Type} (xs : List T) (start stop : Nat) : Result (List T) :=
  if start ≤ stop ∧ stop ≤ xs.length then ok (window xs start stop)
  else fail .arrayOutOfBounds

theorem success {T : Type} (xs : List T) (start stop : Nat)
    (ordered : start ≤ stop) (bounded : stop ≤ xs.length) :
    index xs start stop = ok (window xs start stop) := by
  simp only [index,ordered,bounded,and_self,if_true]

theorem reversed {T : Type} (xs : List T) (start stop : Nat)
    (invalid : stop < start) : index xs start stop = fail .arrayOutOfBounds := by
  simp only [index,show ¬start ≤ stop from by omega,false_and,if_false]

theorem oversized {T : Type} (xs : List T) (start stop : Nat)
    (invalid : xs.length < stop) : index xs start stop = fail .arrayOutOfBounds := by
  simp only [index,show ¬stop ≤ xs.length from by omega,and_false,if_false]

theorem length {T : Type} (xs : List T) (start stop : Nat)
    (bounded : stop ≤ xs.length) : (window xs start stop).length = stop-start := by
  simp only [window,List.length_take,List.length_drop]
  exact Nat.min_eq_left (by omega)

/-- Empty views retain no element, for every position, including a position
beyond the source (whose checked index still fails separately). -/
theorem empty {T : Type} (xs : List T) (n : Nat) : window xs n n = [] := by
  simp only [window,Nat.sub_self,List.take_zero]

/-- The identity view preserves every element and order; no allocation or
copy-property is assumed by this statement. -/
theorem full {T : Type} (xs : List T) : window xs 0 xs.length = xs := by
  simp only [window,Nat.sub_zero,List.drop_zero,List.take_length]

#print axioms success
#print axioms reversed
#print axioms oversized
#print axioms length
#print axioms empty
#print axioms full
end R1Z.PV_RDCD4_SliceRange194

PV_RDCD4_V197.text:
import R1Z.PV_RDCD4_ParserWindows
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PV_RDCD4_V197
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result PV_RDCD4_BytesSource
/-- Explicit complete-Result reference. The second length check remains after
c0's None short circuit. Inputs of length8..15 can therefore return None or
panic exactly as the original source does; no eager16-byte guard is added. -/
def reference (bytes : List U8) : Result (Option Q) :=
  if 8 ≤ bytes.length then do
    let c0 ← cm (PV_RDCD4_SliceRange194.window bytes 0 8)
    match c0 with
    | none => ok none
    | some c0 =>
      if 16 ≤ bytes.length then do
        let c1 ← cm (PV_RDCD4_SliceRange194.window bytes 8 16)
        match c1 with
        | none => ok none
        | some c1 => ok (some ⟨c0,c1⟩)
      else fail .arrayOutOfBounds
  else fail .arrayOutOfBounds

theorem source_reference (bytes : List U8) : qm bytes=reference bytes := by
  unfold qm reference
  by_cases h8 : 8 ≤ bytes.length
  · rw [if_pos h8,PV_RDCD4_SliceRange194.success bytes 0 8 (by omega) h8,bind_tc_ok]
    apply (Aeneas.Std.bind_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr
    intro result _
    cases result with
    | none => rfl
    | some c0 =>
      by_cases h16 : 16 ≤ bytes.length
      · rw [if_pos h16,PV_RDCD4_SliceRange194.success bytes 8 16 (by omega) h16,bind_tc_ok]
      · rw [if_neg h16,PV_RDCD4_SliceRange194.oversized bytes 8 16 (by omega)]
        try rfl
  · rw [if_neg h8,PV_RDCD4_SliceRange194.oversized bytes 0 8 (by omega)]
    try rfl

theorem short_failure (bytes : List U8) (h : bytes.length < 8) :
    qm bytes=fail .arrayOutOfBounds := by
  rw [source_reference,reference,if_neg (by omega)]

/-- Returned values contain no borrow; input storage is unchanged at this
owned value boundary. The rejected extractor/loan-validation route is unused. -/
theorem frame (bytes : List U8) :
    (do let out ← qm bytes;ok (out,bytes))=
      (do let out ← reference bytes;ok (out,bytes)) := by rw [source_reference]
#print axioms source_reference
#print axioms short_failure
#print axioms frame
end R1Z.PV_RDCD4_V197

import R1Z.PV_RDCD5_ParserWindows
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PV_RDCD5_V197
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result PV_RDCD4_BytesSource
/-- Explicit complete-Result reference. The second length check remains after
c0's None short circuit. Inputs of length8..15 can therefore return None or
panic exactly as the original source does; no eager16-byte guard is added. -/
def reference (bytes : List U8) : Result (Option Q) :=
  if 8 ≤ bytes.length then do
    let c0 ← cm (PV_RDCD4_SliceRange194.window bytes 0 8)
    match c0 with
    | none => ok none
    | some c0 =>
      if 16 ≤ bytes.length then do
        let c1 ← cm (PV_RDCD4_SliceRange194.window bytes 8 16)
        match c1 with
        | none => ok none
        | some c1 => ok (some ⟨c0,c1⟩)
      else fail .arrayOutOfBounds
  else fail .arrayOutOfBounds

theorem source_reference (bytes : List U8) : qm bytes=reference bytes := by
  unfold qm reference
  by_cases h8 : 8 ≤ bytes.length
  · rw [if_pos h8,PV_RDCD4_SliceRange194.success bytes 0 8 (by omega) h8,bind_tc_ok]
    apply congrArg (fun f : Option C → Result (Option Q) =>
      cm (PV_RDCD4_SliceRange194.window bytes 0 8) >>= f)
    funext result
    cases result with
    | none => rfl
    | some c0 =>
      dsimp only
      by_cases h16 : 16 ≤ bytes.length
      · rw [if_pos h16,PV_RDCD4_SliceRange194.success bytes 8 16 (by omega) h16,bind_tc_ok]
        rfl
      · rw [if_neg h16,PV_RDCD4_SliceRange194.oversized bytes 8 16 (by omega)]
        rfl
  · rw [if_neg h8,PV_RDCD4_SliceRange194.oversized bytes 0 8 (by omega)]
    rfl

theorem short_failure (bytes : List U8) (h : bytes.length < 8) :
    qm bytes=fail .arrayOutOfBounds := by
  rw [source_reference,reference,if_neg (by omega)]

/-- Original arbitrary-slice carrier, including every short-input branch. -/
theorem slice_instance (bytes : Slice U8) :
    qm bytes.val = reference bytes.val := source_reference bytes.val

/-- Returned values contain no borrow; input storage is unchanged at this
owned value boundary. The rejected extractor/loan-validation route is unused. -/
theorem frame (bytes : List U8) :
    (do let out ← qm bytes;ok (out,bytes))=
      (do let out ← reference bytes;ok (out,bytes)) := by rw [source_reference]
#print axioms source_reference
#print axioms short_failure
#print axioms frame
#print axioms slice_instance
end R1Z.PV_RDCD5_V197

PV_RDCD5_ParserErrors.text:
import R1Z.PV_RDCD5_V197
import R1Z.ProverRwSuccessParserSource
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_RDCD5_ParserErrors
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
/-- Existing callback parser uses panic for an invalid range. -/
theorem existing_empty :
    ProverRwSuccessParserSource.aspis_core.field.QM31.from_le_bytes
      (⟨[],by simp⟩ : Slice U8) = fail .panic := by rfl
/-- The inherited owned model uses a different error constructor. -/
theorem owned_empty : PV_RDCD4_BytesSource.qm [] = fail .arrayOutOfBounds := by
  exact PV_RDCD5_V197.short_failure [] (by simp)
/-- A literal whole-Result identification would therefore be false. -/
theorem carrier_mismatch :
    ProverRwSuccessParserSource.aspis_core.field.QM31.from_le_bytes
      (⟨[],by simp⟩ : Slice U8) ≠ PV_RDCD4_BytesSource.qm [] := by
  rw [existing_empty,owned_empty]
  intro h
  cases h
#print axioms existing_empty
#print axioms owned_empty
#print axioms carrier_mismatch
end R1Z.PV_RDCD5_ParserErrors
